entities.name: Mikheil Kobakhidze
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mikheil Kobakhidze was a Georgian screenwriter, film director, actor and composer. He was born in Tbilisi. A Retrospective of his work was held at the 1996 Venice Film Festival.
